investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Zephyrfold Insurance (insurance); Platform: Microsoft Azure northeurope (zones northeurope-1/northeurope-2/northeurope-3); network range 10.164.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster zephyr-prod-northe (AKS); Istio service mesh (mTLS STRICT); workload certificates are signed by istiod with an intermediate CA certificate that cert-manager obtains from a Vault PKI issuer; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
